```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_record <- 2010L
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_seasons <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(
    classification == "fbs",
    season >= first_record,
    season <= last_season
  ) |>
  collect()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
#| output: false
school <- school_record(fbs_seasons, credited)
tier_levels <- levels(school$tier)
# Each tier's correlation with draft rate, for win % and for average SP+.
cor_by_tier <- function(d, x) {
  d |>
    group_by(tier) |>
    group_modify(\(g, k) {
      ct <- cor.test(g[[x]], g$draft_rate)
      tibble::tibble(
        schools = nrow(g),
        r = unname(ct$estimate),
        lo = ct$conf.int[1],
        hi = ct$conf.int[2]
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}
win_cor <- cor_by_tier(school, "win_pct")
sp_cor <- cor_by_tier(school, "sp")
win_sp <- school |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  summarise(r_win_sp = cor(win_pct, sp), .groups = "drop")
both <- bind_rows(
  mutate(win_cor, measure = "Win %"),
  mutate(sp_cor, measure = "Average SP+")
) |>
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Win %", "Average SP+")))
school$tip <- paste0(
  school$team,
  " (",
  school$tier,
  ")\nRecord 2010 to 2025: ",
  school$record_label,
  ", average SP+ ",
  sprintf("%.1f", school$sp),
  "\n",
  school$drafted,
  " drafted of ",
  school$eligible,
  " eligible (",
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * school$draft_rate),
  ")"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(both, aes(r, tier)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = tidyr::pivot_wider(
      select(both, tier, measure, r),
      names_from = measure,
      values_from = r
    ),
    aes(x = `Win %`, xend = `Average SP+`, y = tier, yend = tier),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#9ca3af",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      color = measure,
      tooltip = paste0(
        tier,
        ", ",
        tolower(as.character(measure)),
        ": r = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", r),
        " (plausible range ",
        sprintf("%.2f", lo),
        " to ",
        sprintf("%.2f", hi),
        ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(tier, measure)
    ),
    size = 7
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Win %" = "#9ca3af", "Average SP+" = "#111827"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(tier_levels)) +
  labs(
    x = "Correlation with draft rate (r)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "SP+ tracks draft rate more closely than win % in both tiers",
    subtitle = "Each row is a tier; the dark dot is average SP+, the grey dot win %",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "sp-plus-and-draft-rate", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 5)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
sp_grid <- school |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  reframe(sp = seq(min(sp), max(sp), length.out = 100)) |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(
      fit_tier_curves(school, "sp")[[as.character(first(tier))]],
      newdata = pick(everything()),
      type = "response"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
p_explore <- ggplot(school, aes(sp, draft_rate)) +
  geom_line(data = sp_grid, aes(y = fit), color = "#9ca3af", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(fill = team, tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.2,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tier, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_team(teams, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Average SP+ (FBS seasons 2010 to 2025)",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Every school's average SP+ and draft rate",
    subtitle = "Team colors; each panel has its own scales; hover a dot for the record and counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_explore, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
win_cor |>
  select(tier, schools, r_win = r) |>
  left_join(select(sp_cor, tier, r_sp = r, lo, hi), by = "tier") |>
  left_join(win_sp, by = "tier") |>
  transmute(
    Tier = tier,
    Schools = schools,
    `r, win % with draft rate` = sprintf("%.2f", r_win),
    `r, SP+ with draft rate` = sprintf("%.2f", r_sp),
    `Plausible range, SP+` = paste(sprintf("%.2f", lo), "to", sprintf("%.2f", hi)),
    `r, win % with SP+` = sprintf("%.2f", r_win_sp)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Tier", "Schools", "r, win % with draft rate", "r, SP+ with draft rate",
      "Plausible range, SP+", "r, win % with SP+"
    ),
    caption = "Correlations with school draft rate (final seasons 2013 to 2025) of win % and of average SP+ (FBS seasons 2010 to 2025), by tier, and of the two measures with each other. The plausible range is the span the SP+ correlation likely falls in (a 95% confidence interval)."
  )
```
